billing.pricing.title: Choose how much you debate
billing.pricing.lede: Every paid plan has the same features and differs only in AI credit each month, with a daily and a weekly share so it lasts all month.
billing.pricing.freeFeatures: 2 debaters, carefully chosen low-cost models, fixed settings
billing.pricing.paidFeatures: 3 debaters, all settings, and your pick of Best, Balanced or Economy models for each debate
billing.pricing.unavailable: The plans can't be shown right now. Please try again in a minute.
billing.pricing.faqLimitsQuestion: What happens when I reach a limit?
billing.pricing.faqLimitsAnswer: You can still ask. Your question waits and starts by itself when the limit resets, or you can upgrade to start now. A debate that is already running always finishes.
billing.pricing.faqCancelAnswer: Yes, at any time, in Settings or on the cancel page without signing in. You keep your plan until the month you paid for ends.
billing.pricing.faqTaxAnswer: Prices are shown before tax. Before you pay, we show the full price with your country's tax.
billing.checkout.title: Subscribe to {plan}
billing.checkout.romaniaNote: A Romanian invoice needs your name, city and county.
billing.checkout.companyIncomplete: Fill in all three company fields, or close the company section.
billing.checkout.countryUnavailable: Paid plans aren't available in your country yet. You can keep using the Free plan.
billing.checkout.confirmCountry: Your connection looks like it's from {ipCountry}. Do you live in {declaredCountry}?
billing.checkout.confirmCountryRequired: Please confirm the country where you live, then continue.
billing.checkout.total: {plan} — {net} + {taxLabel} = {total} per month. Renews on the {day} of each month until you cancel.
billing.consent.renewal: I agree that my subscription renews automatically every month at the price shown, until I cancel. I can cancel at any time in Settings or at dezbatere.ro/cancel.
billing.consent.immediateStart: Start my plan now. I understand that if I withdraw within 14 days, I pay for the part already used: the larger of the days used or the credit used.
billing.checkout.cardNote: You type your card into xMoney's secure form. Your card number never reaches our servers.
billing.checkout.waitingForBank: Waiting for your bank to confirm…
billing.checkout.willEmail: We'll email you as soon as your bank confirms.
billing.checkout.doNotPayAgain: Please don't pay again. Your plan appears in Settings once your bank confirms.
billing.checkout.cardCountryRefused: We can't accept cards issued in that card's country. Any money taken goes back to your card in full.
billing.checkout.refunded: We refunded this payment in full. The email we sent explains why.
billing.checkout.succeeded: Your {plan} plan is active. A confirmation email is on its way.
billing.checkout.failed: The payment didn't go through, and no money was taken. You can try again or use another card.
billing.checkout.taxIdInvalid: That VAT number couldn't be confirmed. Check it, or buy without a company.
billing.checkout.serviceUnavailable: We can't work out the price right now. Please try again in a minute.
billing.checkout.alreadySubscribed: You already have a plan. You can change it in Settings.
billing.checkout.quoteExpired: This price has expired. Show the full price again to continue.
billing.checkout.reacceptRequired: Please accept the updated Terms first, then come back to this page.
billing.checkout.pageOutdated: This page is out of date. Please reload it.
billing.checkout.erasurePending: Your account is scheduled for deletion. Cancel the deletion in Settings to subscribe or change your plan.
billing.checkout.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
billing.checkout.formUnavailable: The card form couldn't be loaded. Please reload the page.
billing.checkout.unknownPlan: That plan doesn't exist. Choose one on the pricing page.
billing.subscription.title: Subscription
billing.subscription.renewalProcessing: We're processing your renewal. Your plan stays active meanwhile.
billing.subscription.endsOn: Your plan ends on {date}. You won't be charged again.
billing.subscription.pastDue: Your last payment failed. You keep your plan while we try again.
billing.subscription.suspended: Paid features are paused while a payment dispute is open.
billing.subscription.upgradeQuote: Pay {total} now for the rest of this month. From {date}, {plan} costs {recurringTotal} a month, tax included, until you cancel.
billing.subscription.upgradeFailed: The payment for the upgrade didn't go through. Nothing changed.
billing.subscription.upgradeInProgress: Your last upgrade payment is still being confirmed. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
billing.subscription.upgradeNotAvailable: Your plan is about to renew, so an upgrade can't start right now. You can upgrade as soon as the renewal has gone through.
billing.subscription.upgradeNotHigher: That plan isn't higher than your current plan. To move to a lower plan, choose it for your next renewal.
billing.subscription.downgradeNotLower: That plan isn't lower than your current plan.
billing.subscription.downgradeNotAvailab: Your plan is renewing right now, so a change can't be scheduled yet. You can change it as soon as the renewal has gone through.
billing.subscription.downgradeConfirm: Move to {plan} at your next renewal? It costs {price} a month + tax, from {date}.
billing.subscription.downgraded: Done. You'll move to {plan} on {date}, for {total} a month, tax included.
billing.subscription.cancelConfirm: Cancel your plan? You keep it until {date}.
billing.subscription.cancelConfirmPastDu: Cancel your plan? It ends now, and we stop trying to take the payment.
billing.subscription.withdrawHint: You can withdraw until {date}. You get back the price minus the part already used: the larger of the days used or the credit used.
billing.subscription.stepUpExpired: Please confirm it's you again: that confirmation expired or was already used.
billing.subscription.withdrawDone: Done. We refunded {amount} to your card.
billing.subscription.withdrawRefused: The withdrawal couldn't be completed. Check your password and code, then try again.
billing.subscription.withdrawNothingDue: Done. Your plan has ended. The part you already used covers the whole price, so nothing was due back.
billing.subscription.withdrawOwnerReview: Your plan has ended. A refund was already made on one of your payments, so we'll check what is still due and email you within 14 days.
billing.subscription.withdrawWindowClose: The 14-day withdrawal period has ended, or it doesn't apply where you live. You can still cancel at any time.
billing.subscription.stillConfirming: We're still confirming this with the payment provider. Check this page again in a few minutes.
billing.subscription.actionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
billing.card.title: Update your card
billing.card.intro: We check the new card with your bank before we save it.
billing.card.holdNote: To check the new card, your bank shows a hold of {amount}. We release it at once; it is never charged.
billing.card.noHoldNote: Your bank checks the new card. Nothing is charged.
billing.card.saved: Your new card is saved. Future payments use it.
billing.card.failed: The card couldn't be checked. Nothing changed.
billing.card.countryRefused: We can't accept cards issued in that card's country. The hold on it is released, and your plan keeps the card it had.
billing.card.tryAgainShortly: We couldn't save your new card just now because a payment on your plan is still being confirmed. Your current card stays in use; please try again in an hour.
billing.card.notSubscribed: You need an active plan to change the card.
billing.cancelPage.title: Cancel your plan
billing.cancelPage.lede: Enter the email address of your account. We'll send you a link that cancels your plan. You don't need to sign in.
billing.cancelPage.sent: If a plan exists for this address, we've sent a link. It works once, for 24 hours.
billing.cancelPage.confirmLede: Your plan won't renew and you won't be charged again. If a payment is overdue, your plan ends now. Otherwise you keep it until the end of the month you paid for.
billing.cancelPage.done: Your plan is cancelled and you won't be charged again. We'll email you the date your access ends.
billing.cancelPage.linkInvalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one below.
billing.cancelPage.signedInHint: Signed in? You can also cancel in Settings.
billing.withdrawPage.title: Withdraw from your contract
billing.withdrawPage.who: If you live in the EU, the EEA or the UK, you can withdraw from a paid plan within 14 days of subscribing, without giving a reason.
billing.withdrawPage.refund: You get back the price minus the part already used: the larger of the days used or the credit used. The money goes back to your card, and the plan ends at once.
billing.withdrawPage.how: Sign in and open Settings, then Subscription, then Withdraw.
billing.withdrawPage.byEmail: You can also send the model withdrawal form from your confirmation email, or any clear statement that you withdraw, to {email}. We carry it out and confirm it by email.
